newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyon-Satolas air cargo up 10.5 pct Jan-July 1996.
newsitem.headline: Lyon-Satolas air cargo up 10.5 pct Jan-July 1996.

text.p: Airfreight traffic handled at Lyon-Satolas airport in the first seven months of the year totalled 12,275 tonnes, up 10.5 percent on the same period in 1995, airport authority figures show.

The main factor in the strong growth in cargo throughput was the volume carried on intra-EU routes, most of it in the form of express shipments, which increased by 16 percent to 5,444 tonnes, the airport authority added.
Postal traffic handled at Lyon-Satolas totalled 8,068 tonnes, up 2.6 percent on the first seven months of 1995.
United Parcel Service of America Inc, DHL Worldwide Express and TNT Ltd each operate air cargo services at Lyon-Satolas.

UPS recently announced the launch of feeder flights between Lyon and three other French cities - Bordeaux, Toulouse and Nice from next month, using Beechcraft 1900 aircraft. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
